init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for SLURM multi-node multi-GPU jobs using params object
init_signal_handler: install SLURM signal handlers to handle job pre-emption and time limit signals
get_gloo_group: retrieve the Gloo distributed process group for cross-node communication in PyTorch
sig_handler: handle SIGUSR1 signals by requeuing the SLURM job on the main process
term_handler: handle SIGTERM signals by logging and bypassing termination for graceful shutdown
